name: Asuka Fujimoto
source:
The most popular girl in Shimizu High, a queen for many boys, but no one has ever been brave enough to confess to her.

She views almost everything negatively and is rare to smile. People just regard her as her beeing cool, but there is a actually a dark and painful past hidden deep under the facade.
